intro: Connect to RabbitMQ, choose a queue and watch a private copy of its incoming traffic. Your application queue stays yours.
emptyResources: Connect to a broker to explore its queues, streams and exchanges.
chooseQueue: Choose a queue to inspect its routes.
bindingHint: New traffic only. Existing backlog is not copied. Binding changes require refreshing this snapshot.
partialHint: Unsupported routes will be omitted. Mirroring adds broker load and can affect routing-existence checks.
noCapture: Start a capture to see incoming messages here.
chooseMessage: Select a message to inspect its payload and properties.
sessionHint: Secure OS storage is unavailable or disabled for tests. Connections are kept in memory; temporary encrypted captures are removed on exit.
error: The operation failed. Check endpoints, permissions, settings and available disk space.
serviceError: The local service is unavailable. Restart QueueCumber to recover; active captures may have a gap.
appearanceHint: Keep your workspace comfortable for long debugging sessions.
limitsHint: Finite budgets, on your terms. The RAM budget controls message cache, not total application memory.
rate: Capture rate (messages/second, blank = no rate limit)
confirmEffects: Apply changed limits? Existing captures will stop; older retained messages may be evicted.
previewTruncated: Preview is limited. Original retained bytes are preserved on disk.
omission: This delivery was omitted because it exceeded a configured capture limit.
potentialOverflow: Broker buffer is finite; overload may cause uncounted gaps.
closeBehavior: Closing the window stops this MVP. Tray mode arrives in 0.2.
invalidSettings: Check positive values, units and budget relationships.
name: Name
futureResource: This resource can be explored; its subscription workflow is planned for a later milestone.
connectionHint: Credentials stay in privileged processes after saving. Use amqps:// and HTTPS for remote brokers.
stopBeforeSettings: Saving limits stops active captures so new budgets apply consistently.
